Sure! To terminate any running instance of `timer.exe`, you can use the following command:

```cmd
taskkill /IM timer.exe /F
```

If you also want to delete the executable file itself (assuming it’s in the current directory), you can run:

```cmd
del timer.exe
```

If `timer.exe` is located elsewhere, let me know its full path so I can adjust the command accordingly.
